visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An Asian male host with dark, styled hair and wearing a black textured ribbed shirt sits at a desk. He is positioned in front of a dark brown laptop with a visible Apple logo. The background is a bright, airy indoor space with a white wall and a green potted plant. He looks directly at the camera, speaking and using hand gestures for emphasis. (2) A split-screen layout appears. The upper half features a blonde woman in a pink short-sleeved blouse, speaking and gesturing with her hands in a modern office environment with large windows. The lower half shows the male host listening intently, his hand resting on his chin in a thoughtful posture. (3) A brief scene transition shows a person sitting on a bed in a dark room illuminated by cool teal and blue light. The person is wrapped in a thick blanket and looks downward with a troubled facial expression, suggesting difficulty sleeping or distress. (4) The video returns to the split-screen format. The blonde expert continues her technical explanation while the male host maintains his listening pose in the bottom frame. (5) The screen switches back to a full shot of the male host. He continues to speak to the audience, his laptop still open before him. His facial expressions are serious and engaged as he poses further questions. (6) Another split-screen sequence begins. The top frame shows the female expert speaking. The bottom frame is replaced by a digital screen recording of an iPhone displaying a line graph titled "Breathing Disturbances," with various data points and text descriptions in English. (7) An animation on the iPhone screen shows a notification for "Possible Sleep Apnea" alongside a graphical heart icon. An Apple Watch with a heart rate interface is shown next to the phone. The expert remains visible in the top split-screen frame, continuing her narration.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 各位 今天超難得. 我要訪問 Apple 的資深產品行銷. 首先 Apple 為什麼選擇. 「睡眠呼吸中止症」作為這一波. Apple Watch 的研究重點? 這背後有什麼觀察嗎? (2) [Subtitle]: 睡眠呼吸中止症是一種睡眠障礙. 患者在睡眠時呼吸會暫時停止. 對人體造成很大的壓力. 屬於慢性病. 可能導致嚴重的健康問題. 如高血壓. 第二型糖尿病與心臟疾病. 這也是我們積極推出. 「睡眠呼吸中止症通知功能」的原因. 當系統持續偵測到中度到重度的. 呼吸中止症症狀時. 會主動通知使用者. 協助提升就醫率. (3) [Subtitle]: 另外我想問的是. 那 Apple Watch 是怎麼做到的? 為什麼戴著手錶就可以偵測? (4) [Subtitle]: 為了偵測睡眠呼吸中止. Apple Watch 透過加速計. 監測一項新的睡眠指標. 「呼吸中止程度」. 這個全新指標的優勢. 在於能偵測到人體的細微動作. 進一步掌握睡眠狀態. 而且只需佩戴手錶就能測量. 十分令人驚艷. (5) [Subtitle]: 每隔 30 天. 系統會分析呼吸中止數據. 並發送通知. 當偵測到使用者持續出現. 中度到重度的睡眠呼吸中止症狀時. 會提醒儘速就醫.
